features_verified: 1. POST /api/purchases: confidence_reason field returned on each item
2. confidence_reason = 'All checks passed' for trusted items
3. confidence_reason = 'Math mismatch (qty × price ≠ total)' for math errors
4. confidence_reason = 'Pack size could not be parsed' for failed pack parse
5. confidence_reason = 'Missing item name' for empty name
7. confidence_reason = 'Suspicious values detected' for suspicious patterns
8. Frontend: trusted items show green dot + 'Trusted' or 'Confirmed' badge
9. Frontend: unverified items show amber dot + 'Unverified' badge + reason text
10. Frontend: 'Fix' button on unverified items toggles fix mode (blue ring on qty/price)
11. Frontend: editing qty or price in fix mode auto-recalculates total
12. Frontend: 'Accept' button marks item as reviewed (green 'Confirmed' badge)
13. Frontend: review banner count updates correctly as items are fixed/accepted
14. Frontend: $/LB shows '—' for unverified items, shows value for trusted/confirmed items
15. Frontend: Focus Review toggle filters to only unverified items
